sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Specialized Air/Sea Transport of Regulated Hazardous Chemicals

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with codified commercial law; corporate, maritime and trust/foundation statutes containing common-law-inspired features)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), investment chapter
Canada–Panama Free Trade Agreement (FTA), investment protections

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 32 of 1927 (General Law on Corporations), as amended, including Law No. 5 of 2018 and Law No. 1 of 2020; Law No. 23 of 27 June 2015, as amended by Law No. 254 of 2021, together with implementing Executive Decree No. 166 of 2015; Law No. 129 of 18 March 2020 establishing the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO register) for Panamanian legal persons and private-interest foundations, implemented by Executive Decree No. 136 of 2021 and applicable Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) resolutions; relevant Public Registry, Financial Analysis Unit (UAF), and banking/securities supervisory AML/CFT regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) from each intended shareholder and director to the Panamanian incorporation attorney or registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's or director's country of origin; Panamanian consulate where the document is executed in a non-Hague Apostille jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the issuing country's competent authority; otherwise Panamanian Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copies of passport or national identity document of all proposed directors, officers and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country notary public, issuing passport authority or designated certification authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Panamanian Consular Legalization where not notarized before a Panamanian notary

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 – General Law on Corporations of Panama (as amended), arts. 1–35 (incorporation), art. 4 (minimum authorized capital), arts. 39–41 (officers and board); Ley 5 de 1993 (Public Registry rules) as amended; Código de Comercio (Book II) applies subsidiarily.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección General del Registro, Sección Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) executed before a Panamanian Notary Public; deed and appended bylaws (Pacto Social) are inscribed in the Mercantile Section.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Art. 4, Ley 32 de 1927 requires authorized capital of at least USD 10,000, divisible into shares; no mandatory paid-up capital or escrow deposit at incorporation, and shares may be issued in installments, subject to Panamanian stamp tax on paid issuance.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [CORP.] S.A. — RESOLUTION NO. 2024-001. The directors confirm the registered Public Deed, approve the issue and allocation of authorized shares, and appoint officers. RESOLVED: 1. Registered office established at the resident agent's offices, [Agent], Panama City. 2. [Name], [Name] and [Name] appointed President, Secretary and Treasurer with joint signatory powers over corporate bank and payment platforms (SWIFT, wires, letters of credit). 3. Officers authorized to obtain the RUC, municipal Aviso de Operación, and SINAPROC/ANA/DGI dangerous-goods licensing and tax permits. 4. Corporate seal, stock ledger and minutes book adopted for the ISIC 5229 DG-forwarding operations. Passed unanimously on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil (online name consultation or in-person clerk desk)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name-search request listing three candidate names ending in 'Corp.', 'S.A.' or 'Inc.' and ensure no identical or confusingly similar name exists in the Mercantile Section index. Upon clearance, obtain the Certificado de Reserva de Nombre (name reservation certificate), valid for 30 calendar days, renewable once.
required_dossiers: Solicitud de búsqueda de nombre (completed application form)
Photocopy of each incorporator's passport or national ID
Power of attorney executed by the incorporators, if acting through counsel or an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a preventive notice due to confusing similarity or prohibited words, file a written objection or reconsideration request within 2 working days, proposing a visually and phonetically distinct variation; alternatively, promptly submit a new candidate name within the reservation window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública in the Republic of Panama (e.g., Notaría Primera del Circuito de Panamá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the draft Escritura Pública de Constitución to the notary, including the corporate name, corporate purpose covering ISIC 5229 specialized air/sea forwarding of regulated hazardous chemicals, authorized capital structure, resident agent appointment and any shortened corporate duration clause. The notary reads the deed, obtains wet-ink signatures of the incorporators or their attorney-in-fact, and records the deed in the notarial protocol.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Draft public deed of incorporation
Passport or ID of each incorporator
Resident agent's signed acceptance letter
Registered office address statement of the resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies defective signatures, inconsistent ID data, or an overbroad purpose clause, the incorporators must execute a corrective addendum or substitute deed before the same notary within 5 business days, with all affected signatures notarized anew.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Public Registry of Panama (Mercantile Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil, Ventanilla de Inscripción de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarial protocol quotation and two legalized copies of the Escritura Pública together with proof of payment of the registry inscription fee. Upon review, the deed and the Pacto Social (bylaws) are indexed and inscribed in the Mercantile Section; the Registry issues the inscription number and returns certified copies with margin annotations.
required_dossiers: Protocol copy of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Official fee payment receipt (Liquidación de Ingresos)
Resident agent's registered address certificate
Name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any 'Prevención' (defect cure notice) from the Registry must be answered within 5 working days by correcting the indicated defects; if the inscription is wrongfully refused, file an internal 'Recurso de Reconsideración' with the Dirección General del Registro within 5 working days, followed by a judicial appeal 'Recurso de Apelación' before the appropriate Circuit Court within 10 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Corporate Kit: Stock Certificates, Share Ledger, Minutes Book and Corporate Seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent (licensed law firm or trust company) and the duly appointed officers of the Sociedad Anónima
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, the resident agent delivers the certificate of registration, certified bylaws, and pre-printed stock certificates. The officers execute the share allocation resolution, affix the corporate seal, issue founders' shares, and enter all allotments in the share ledger. Corporate books are consecutively numbered, sealed, and certified by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Registry inscription certificate
Certified copy of the Pacto Social (registered bylaws)
First Board Resolution approving share issuance
Registered agent's certified corporate records book
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the share ledger, certificates, or resolutions contain statutory or registry inconsistencies (e.g., aggregate par value differing from registered capital), correct through a unanimous board resolution and, if necessary, request a margin note from the Mercantile Section within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Municipal Business License Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Municipalidad de Panamá or the local municipality where the office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File for the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) through the DGI's Sede Electrónica or physical windows to obtain the NIT, affirm the territorial income tax regime and register for ITBMS where applicable. Designate the registered office as tax domicile; thereafter file the municipal 'Aviso de Operación' accompanied by the registry certificate and lease title.
required_dossiers: Registry inscription certificate
DGI RUC registration forms
Registered agent's authorization letter
Lease agreement or proof of premises ownership
Identification document of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI queries inconsistent capital or activity codes, file a 'Rectificación de Datos' within 5 working days; if the municipality denies the Aviso de Operación, cure by submitting the fire inspection certificate, approved floor plans, or updated occupational safety clearance from the competent authorities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Sistema Nacional de Protección Civil (SINAPROC) – Dirección de Riesgos Químicos; Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA) – Dirección de Agentes de Carga; Municipalidad de Panamá (Aviso de Operación/Patente Comercial)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Municipal Commercial Operating License); ANA License as International Freight Forwarder / Cargo Agent (including customs broker status); SINAPROC Authorization for Enterprises Handling and Transporting Dangerous Goods (class 1–9).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II – Preliminary Environmental Impact Assessment (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental Preliminar) for DG forwarding operations including transit or short-term warehousing; Category III full EIA required for new facilities storing substantial volumes of hazardous chemicals; office-only operations may fall under Category I registration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Ley 41 de 2007 (General Environment Law) and Decreto 57 de 2004 (EIA Regulations); wastewater and leachate from any transfer or deconsolidation areas must meet the national discharge limits (Executive Decree No. 7 of 2015 and applicable Copanit/AGC technical standards); hazardous waste generated (spent absorbents, contaminated PPE, DG residue) must be registered under the MiAMBIENTE waste manifest system; VOC and particulate concentrations in handling areas must be controlled to internationally recognized occupational exposure thresholds (ACGIH TLV/NIOSH) and maintained within IMDG/ICAO segregation, spill containment and transportation safety standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de la República de Panamá; structural load inspection and certificate for racks, mezzanines, and dock platforms by a Panama-licensed professional engineer; occupational health and safety registration and workplace inspection clearance from the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL); and, where cargo is stored, SINAPROC civil defense clearance for segregated Class 1–9 dangerous goods storage areas.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Panamá; centralized portal: https://dgi.mef.gob.pa (electronic services: ETax / SIFE / RUC registry).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity or its duly appointed Panama resident fiscal representative must register the entity in the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) before the DGI. Required filings include: (i) certificate of incorporation and current bylaws attested from the Public Registry (Registro Público de Panamá); (ii) notarized power of attorney appointing a resident legal representative; (iii) identification documents of directors/shareholders; (iv) physical address declaration for the Panama registered office; and (v) if applicable, a DG freight forwarding license. The DGI issues a NIT/RUC certificate; no minimum paid-up capital is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope (entity-level taxation on Panama-source income only). A Panamanian Sociedad Anónima is a juridical person subject to corporate income tax (ISR); foreign-source income and capital gains arising outside Panama are outside the territorial taxation net. It is not a pass-through entity; no entity-exempt status applies unless a special export-processing-zone license is separately granted.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch/mandatory disclosure elections are available under Panamanian tax law for an S.A. The only administratively recognized status election is the 'pequeño contribuyente' simplified regime for taxpayers with annual gross turnover up to B/.36,000; that election affects filing frequency and ITBMS settlement, but does not change the S.A.'s entity-level corporate tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS); Panamanian VAT-equivalent.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/.36,000 (equivalent to USD 36,000, Panamanian balboa pegged 1:1 to US dollar) of annual gross taxable sales/services; below this level an entity may register as a pequeño contribuyente or, if taxable operations exceed it, must register as a full ITBMS taxpayer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing applies to all active RUC holders through DGI's Sistema de Facturación Electrónica (SIFE). Invoice documents must be transmitted and validated by DGI in near-real time; paper invoices require DGI-authorized fiscal printing/QR seal. Each export invoice must carry the DGI authorized electronic invoice code and no ITBMS suspended amount. Failed or out-of-band invoices are inadmissible for customs and ITBMS credit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of movable goods and, where qualifying, offshore services are subject to ITBMS at 0%, provided the seller is an active RUC holder, the goods are physically shipped from Panama to a foreign destination, or the service is supplied to a non-resident recipient and used wholly outside Panama. For DG freight forwarding, the 0% applies only to services directly connected to the export movement and supported by the export transport documentation; ancillary local services (e.g., local storage or domestic haulage) remain taxable at 7%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación / DUE) filed with the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA) and electronic validation in SISCOM
Bill of Lading or original Air Waybill issued by the carrier showing Panama as port/place of shipment and foreign destination
Commercial Invoice endorsed 'EXPORTACIÓN - ITBMS 0%' with the DGI-authorized electronic invoice code
Shipper's Declaration for Dangerous Goods (IMO/multi-modal) evidencing the UN-classified dangerous goods shipment
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit evidence from a Panama-licensed bank showing transfer of export proceeds
Insurance certificate/packing list only where required by ANA risk assessment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is aggressively audited by the DGI and ANA. If the export documentation is found false, incomplete, or non-repatriated proceeds are involved, the exporter is required to reinstate the 7% ITBMS plus interest from the date of invoice, a surcharge of up to 200% of the omitted tax in fraud cases, and administrative fines, with potential criminal liability for customs smuggling and tax evasion under the Código Fiscal and Código Penal. Prior-year zero-rating credits may be retroactively reversed within the statute of limitations (generally 5 years).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP — Superintendency of Banks of Panama); Panama has no traditional central bank. The US Dollar circulates as full legal tender under the 1904 Currency Law, and the SBP is the de facto banking and foreign-exchange supervisory authority, with Banco Nacional de Panamá acting as the state clearing and government collection agent.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full de facto dollarization eliminates local currency convertibility risk: both current and capital account transactions are freely convertible, with zero surrender, prior-authorization, or repatriation requirements. Dividend/profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted but are operationally subject to the 10% dividend withholding tax, the distributable-dividends declaration platform, and the SBP-required source-of-funds and OFAC/sanctions-compliant USD clearing corridor.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Panama imposes no statutory timeline, conversion ratio, or surrender obligation on DG forwarding export receipts. Proceeds may be retained in USD or any foreign currency in domestic or offshore accounts; reporting is limited to electronic invoicing (e-Factura), ITBMS tax filings, and standard corporate ISR returns.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with Trade Finance line
Capital Escrow Account + Operational Account with SWIFT/LC facilities

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Medium (constrained). Panama's Fintech Law No. 70 of 2021 and SBP innovation regulations permit licensed local fintech and EMI-type virtual accounts, but offshore digital EMIs without an SBP banking license cannot serve as settlement-grade treasury rails (no LC issuance, no escrow, no correspondent USD clearing). Such EMIs are viable only for ancillary vendor payouts, petty-cash floats, and low-volume disbursements; any high-value DG forwarding settlement must route through an SBP-licensed commercial bank to avoid correspondent de-risking and FATF 'nested account' refusals.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for hazardous-goods forwarding companies. SBP-licensed banks require in-person KYC interviews for the beneficial owners and at least two designated signatories at first account activation; remote/video onboarding is generally not accepted for this AML High_Risk_Special_License segment and, where exceptionally offered, is conditioned on notarized board resolutions, legalized constitutional documents, and a separate compliance call with the bank's EDD team.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Industry red-flag: specialized transport of regulated hazardous chemicals is presumptively high-risk; banks may decline at sectoral level or trigger Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory license bundle: Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP) permanent DG shipping license; Autoridad Aeronáutica Civil (AAC) air-cargo forwarding license; MINSA hazardous materials transport authorization; Customs Broker license (agente aduanero) registered at the Single Window (SIC); IMO-IMDG and IATA-DGR staff training certificates; ISO 28000 supply-chain security certification; and original transport contracts/letter of intent with verified shipping lines.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and cargo-party mismatch: cargo manifests referencing OFAC/UN/UK/EU listed ports, flagged vessels, or denied-party shippers/consignees generate automatic compliance referral and possible account freeze.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Real-time sanctions screening policy against OFAC SDN/SSI, UN Consolidated List, and EU/UK consolidated lists; archived bills of lading, cargo manifests, vessel IMO numbers, certificates of origin, and INCOTERMS 2020 contract files; an appointed Compliance Officer with ninety-day lookback remediation reports and transaction-tracing documentation for all historical DG shipments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership: failure to update the Beneficial Ownership Registry (RTB) or use of legacy bearer-share holding patterns causes onboarding refusal.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current RTB registration certificate issued under Law 254 of 2021, annual Formulario RTB declarations filed on time, fully endorsed shareholder register showing all natural-person beneficial owners, stamped share-transfer forms, and an absolute attestation that no bearer shares remain outstanding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds ambiguity on capital escrow: multiple high-value inbound wires into the escrow account without clear trade rationale may be treated as suspicious activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share subscription minutes, stamped capital subscription and payment templates, signed escrow memorandum, originator-bank compliance/wealth statements, audited or reviewed financials of the funding shareholder, and a registered accountant's sworn letter (carta de contador) documenting the source and economic purpose of each injected tranche.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing is via SWIFT MT103/MT103 GPI same-day USD clearing from the foreign shareholder's bank to the Panama receiving bank, with field 70 noting 'Capital Contribution — Share Subscription — DG Forwarding OpCo'. No FX conversion occurs because of full dollarization. The receiving bank mandates pre-funding submission of stamped board/shareholder minutes, capitalization schedule, source-of-funds questionnaires, and sanctions screening on both parties; wires arriving without matched corporate documentation are placed in suspense and may trigger EDD.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails are SWIFT MT103 for general DG trade payables and MT103 GPI for time-critical settlements, supplemented by commercial documentary letters of credit (usance or at-sight) issued under ICC UCP600 and INCOTERMS 2020 for high-value or high-risk chemical purchases. Standby letters of credit support DG tender guarantees. Local obligations (stevedoring, port charges, warehousing) clear through the Panamanian ACH; all USD overseas settlements must settle through New York correspondents, retaining full OFAC compliance and field-70 invoice references.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/EUR deliverable FX forward (3- to 12-month tenors) through SBP-licensed bank international desks for transatlantic DG freight and chemical purchase invoices
USD/JPY deliverable FX forward for Japan-lane air/sea DG shipments with JPY-denominated cost recovery
USD/CNH (offshore RMB) non-deliverable forward (NDF) settled in USD for China-lane DG imports and freight billing in RMB
Cross-currency swap (USD/EUR or USD/CNH) with ISDA 2002 Master Agreement for long-term DG fleet, equipment, and facility capital financing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única Anual de Personas Jurídicas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Panama Ministry of Economy and Finance; paid through the Panamanian Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 10% plus monthly judicial interest; continued non-payment for two consecutive years enables administrative strike-off and dissolution by the Registro Público.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Final Beneficial Owner (UBO) Annual Confirmation – Registo de Beneficiario Final
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Beneficial Owner Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March, concurrently with the annual franchise tax; supplementary update required within 15 calendar days after any ownership or control change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalties up to USD 10,000 for incorrect or late declarations; registration suspension and interdiction of corporate rights may apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Dangerous Goods / Hazardous Cargo Forwarding Permit (Maritime and/or Air)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Panama Maritime Authority (AMP) – Directorate of Logistics and Cargo Agents; and/or Directorate of Civil Aviation (AAC) for air cargo operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the permit anniversary date or as prescribed in the operating license conditions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Immediate suspension of cargo forwarding operations, administrative fines per violation, loss of license, and potential registration of the company as non-operational.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for any Panama corporation with annual gross sales exceeding USD 3,000,000 or total assets exceeding USD 1,500,000; DG forwarding firms subject to AMP/AAC supervision may be required to present audited financial statements as a condition of license renewal.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted in Panama under Law 7 of 2005; IFRS for SMEs is permissible for entities below the audit threshold.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Panama S.A. must file an annual declaration of its final beneficial owner with the DGI Registry through its registered agent. The declaration identifies all natural persons controlling directly or indirectly more than 10% of shares, voting rights, or management. The filing is compulsory for the annual franchise tax and must be updated within 15 days of any relevant change.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registro de Junta Directiva)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 – USD 1,200 per year depending on the registered agent and office service provider
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – USD 7,000 per year for a certified independent audit of a DG forwarding entity with moderate activity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat corporate income tax (ISR) on Panama-source net taxable income under the General Regime of the Código Fiscal
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial exclusion: 0% Panamanian corporate tax on documented foreign-source income (active and passive) for a qualifying offshore DG forwarding S.A.; no preferential rate reduction below 25% under the General Regime; available incentives include the Panama Pacifico SEM/SIEM income tax exemptions for licensed logistics operators, the Law 8 of 2010 additional deduction of up to 3% for local fixed-asset investment, and the credit mechanics for the 2% quarterly anticipo against the annual ISR,

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 301 (Declaración Jurada Anual de Impuesto sobre la Renta); filed exclusively via the DGI e-Tax 2.0 electronic portal of the Dirección General de Ingresos, Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (https://etax.mef.gob.pa).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within three months after the close of the fiscal year; calendar-year entities must file by March 31 of the following year, without extension.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identificación del contribuyente: full corporate name, RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente), and DGI branch code.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident S.A. must hold an active RUC and a valid resident agent before filing; RUC cancellation or inactive status blocks submission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Período gravable: the 12-month fiscal period covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities must align this period with the financial statements and all Form 307 quarterly anticipos; short periods are accepted only at first registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos brutos totales: aggregate gross receipts from all DG forwarding and ancillary logistics activities, before deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must include all revenue related to the Panamanian entity, including Panama-source and foreign-source cargo fees, to permit a verifiable territorial sourcing split.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos gravables de fuente panameña: revenue attributable to Panama-source activity (cargo handling, warehousing, and transport legs performed within Panamanian territory or territorial waters).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers should include only Panama-source revenue; each allocation must be supported by bills of lading, warehouse receipts, and service contracts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos exentos / no gravables de fuente extranjera: foreign-source freight revenue excluded under the territorial system.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must provide origin/destination documentation, carrier certificates, and foreign counterparty contracts; unsupported allocations are recharacterized as Panama-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costos directos e indirectos: costs incurred to generate the taxable Panama-source revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers may deduct only costs that are necessary, evidenced by electronic F-20 invoices, and consistent with transfer pricing for intercompany freight and logistics charges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Renta neta gravable: Panama-source gross revenue less attributable costs and deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers should reconcile this figure with the quarterly anticipo base; a mismatch triggers automatic DGI cross-checks.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Impuesto sobre la renta determinado: 25% multiplying factor applied to the net taxable base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must verify that no territorial exemption is improperly applied to Panama-source profits before computing the 25% rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Créditos por anticipos y retenciones: credits for quarterly Form 307 prepayments and third-party withholding receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must attach the stamped/payment evidence of the four 2% anticipos; missing anticipos trigger recargo assessments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Saldo por pagar o crédito a favor: final settlement or carryable credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must pay the balance through the DGI payment gateway or authorized banks; a refund claim is subject to DGI audit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fine of B/. 50 per month or fraction (cap B/. 500), plus 5% monthly surcharge on the tax due (cap 50%), plus legal interest; submission of false data: penalty up to 100% of the omitted tax and criminal tax-fraud prosecution (2–5 years imprisonment).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 307 (Declaración de Pago Trimestral del Impuesto sobre la Renta — Anticipo ISR); e-Tax 2.0 DGI portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 15 days after the close of each quarter: Q1 by April 15, Q2 by July 15, Q3 by October 15, and Q4 by January 15 of the following year for calendar-year taxpayers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must file even with a nil balance; RUC must remain active.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Trimestre fiscal: the calendar quarter being declared.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must match the quarter to the annual fiscal period registered with DGI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ingresos brutos gravados del trimestre: Panama-source gross revenue for the quarter.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers should use the same territorial allocation methodology as the annual Form 301 to avoid inconsistencies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Anticipo a pagar: 2% of the gross taxable revenue line (or the substitute tax-computation method chosen by the taxpayer).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must compute the 2% strictly on Panama-source revenue; foreign-source amounts are excluded only where the allocation is defensible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total a pagar: settlement of the quarter's anticipo with bank or gateway stamp.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filers must preserve the payment receipt for the Form 301 credit schedule.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-payment/underpayment of quarterly anticipos: 5% monthly surcharge on the unpaid amount (cap 50%) plus legal interest; failure to file: B/. 50 monthly fine (cap B/. 500); repeated non-compliance triggers immediate full annual settlement and consolidated debt enforcement against the entity and its assets.
